items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "type" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "type" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: type /taɪp/ (động từ): gõ (bàn phím). "Type a web address" = gõ địa chỉ web; khi là danh từ, "type" lại nghĩa là "loại, kiểu".
items.explanationEn: type /taɪp/ (verb): to write using a keyboard. "Type a web address" means entering it with the keyboard; as a noun, "type" means "kind, sort".

items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "address" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "address" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: address /əˈdres/ (danh từ): địa chỉ (web). "Web address" = địa chỉ web (URL); "address" cũng có nghĩa "bài phát biểu" trong ngữ cảnh khác.
items.explanationEn: address /əˈdres/ (noun): the location of a site. "Web address" is another name for a URL; in other contexts "an address" is a formal speech.

items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "press" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "press" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to push a key or button
items.explanation: press /pres/ (động từ): nhấn (phím, nút). "Press Enter" = nhấn phím Enter; thường gặp trong hướng dẫn: "press the button".
items.explanationEn: press /pres/ (verb): to push a key or button. "Press Enter" means push the Enter key; common in instructions such as "press the button".

items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "a series of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "a series of" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: a number of things in a row
items.explanation: a series of /ə ˈsɪəriːz əv/ (cụm từ): một loạt, chuỗi. "A series of steps" = một chuỗi các bước nối tiếp nhau; động từ đi sau thường chia số nhiều.
items.explanationEn: a series of /ə ˈsɪəriːz əv/ (phrase): a number of things in a row. "A series of steps" means several steps that follow one another in order.

items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "within" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "within" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (giới từ): trong vòng (thời gian). "Within a few hundred milliseconds" = trong vòng vài trăm mili giây; cũng dùng cho không gian: "within the page".
items.explanationEn: within /wɪˈðɪn/ (preposition): inside a period of time. "Within a few hundred milliseconds" means in less than that time; it also works for space: "within the page".

items.question: Trong câu "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", từ "display" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you type a web address into the browser and press Enter, a series of steps happen within a few hundred milliseconds to display the web page.", what does "display" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (động từ): hiển thị. "Display the web page" = hiển thị trang web; danh từ "display" là màn hình.
items.explanationEn: display /dɪˈspleɪ/ (verb): to show on a screen. "Display the web page" means show it on screen; the noun "display" means a screen.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", từ "flow" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", what does "flow" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: flow /fləʊ/ (danh từ): luồng, trình tự xử lý. "Understand this flow" = hiểu luồng xử lý này; hay gặp: "user flow", "data flow".
items.explanationEn: flow /fləʊ/ (noun): a sequence of steps. "This flow" is the sequence of steps; common phrases: "user flow", "data flow".

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", từ "communicate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", what does "communicate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: communicate /kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/ (động từ): giao tiếp, trao đổi. "Communicate with the team" = trao đổi với nhóm; danh từ: communication.
items.explanationEn: communicate /kəˈmjuːnɪkeɪt/ (verb): to share information. "Communicate with the team" means share information with them; noun: communication.

items.question: Trong câu "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", từ "technical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Understanding this flow helps you communicate better with the technical team.", what does "technical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (tính từ): (thuộc) kỹ thuật. "The technical team" = đội kỹ thuật; "technical skills" = kỹ năng chuyên môn kỹ thuật.
items.explanationEn: technical /ˈteknɪkl/ (adjective): related to technology. "The technical team" is the engineering team; "technical skills" are practical tech skills.

items.question: Trong câu "A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is the full address of a resource on the web", từ "uniform" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is the full address of a resource on the web", what does "uniform" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: uniform /ˈjuːnɪfɔːm/ (tính từ): thống nhất, đồng nhất. "Uniform Resource Locator" = bộ định vị tài nguyên thống nhất; là danh từ, "uniform" nghĩa là đồng phục.
items.explanationEn: uniform /ˈjuːnɪfɔːm/ (adjective): the same in every case. "Uniform" here means one consistent format for all addresses; as a noun it means a set of work clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is the full address of a resource on the web", từ "resource" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A URL (Uniform Resource Locator) is the full address of a resource on the web", what does "resource" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a file or item on a network
items.explanation: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (danh từ): tài nguyên (trên mạng). "A resource on the web" = một tài nguyên trên web (trang, ảnh, tệp...); "human resources" = nhân sự.
items.explanationEn: resource /rɪˈzɔːs/ (noun): a file or item on a network. "A resource on the web" is any page, image or file you can reach; "human resources" means staff.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheme: http or https — the protocol used.", từ "protocol" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheme: http or https — the protocol used.", what does "protocol" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: protocol /ˈprəʊtəkɒl/ (danh từ): giao thức (truyền dữ liệu). "The protocol used" = giao thức được dùng (http/https); ngoài IT, "protocol" còn là nghi thức.
items.explanationEn: protocol /ˈprəʊtəkɒl/ (noun): rules for sending data. "The protocol used" is the set of rules for exchanging data; outside IT it also means formal etiquette.

items.question: Trong câu "Scheme: http or https — the protocol used.", từ "scheme" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scheme: http or https — the protocol used.", what does "scheme" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the protocol part of a URL
items.explanation: scheme /skiːm/ (danh từ): phần chỉ giao thức (URL). "Scheme" trong URL là phần đầu như "https"; trong đời thường "a scheme" có thể là một mưu đồ.
items.explanationEn: scheme /skiːm/ (noun): the protocol part of a URL. In a URL the "scheme" is the first part, such as "https"; in daily English "a scheme" can be a sly plan.

items.question: Trong câu "Host: shop.example.com — the destination server.", từ "host" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Host: shop.example.com — the destination server.", what does "host" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: host /həʊst/ (danh từ): máy chủ (chứa trang). "Host" trong URL là tên máy chủ đích; động từ "to host a website" = lưu trữ, vận hành website.
items.explanationEn: host /həʊst/ (noun): the computer serving a site. In a URL the "host" names the server; the verb "to host a website" means to run it on a server.

items.question: Trong câu "Host: shop.example.com — the destination server.", từ "destination" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Host: shop.example.com — the destination server.", what does "destination" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: destination /ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn/ (danh từ): đích đến, nơi nhận. "The destination server" = máy chủ đích mà yêu cầu được gửi tới; trái nghĩa: source, origin.
items.explanationEn: destination /ˌdestɪˈneɪʃn/ (noun): the place something goes to. "The destination server" is where the request is sent; opposites: source, origin.

items.question: Trong câu "Path: /products/detail — the path to the resource.", từ "path" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Path: /products/detail — the path to the resource.", what does "path" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: path /pɑːθ/ (danh từ): đường dẫn (tới tệp). "The path to the resource" = đường dẫn tới tài nguyên, ví dụ /products/detail; "file path" = đường dẫn tệp.
items.explanationEn: path /pɑːθ/ (noun): the route to a file. "The path to the resource" is the route after the host, e.g. /products/detail; also "file path".

items.question: Trong câu "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", từ "query" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", what does "query" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (danh từ): truy vấn, câu hỏi. "Query string" = chuỗi truy vấn sau dấu ?; "run a query" = chạy một truy vấn.
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (noun): a request for information. "Query string" is the part after "?"; "run a query" means ask a database for data.

items.question: Trong câu "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", từ "filter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", what does "filter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: filter /ˈfɪltə(r)/ (danh từ): bộ lọc (điều kiện). "Filter parameters" = tham số lọc kết quả; động từ "filter by price" = lọc theo giá.
items.explanationEn: filter /ˈfɪltə(r)/ (noun): a condition that narrows results. "Filter parameters" narrow down results; the verb: "filter by price".

items.question: Trong câu "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", từ "parameter" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Query String: ?id=123&lang=vi — filter/search parameters.", what does "parameter" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: parameter /pəˈræmɪtə(r)/ (danh từ): tham số. "Search parameters" = tham số tìm kiếm; "pass a parameter" = truyền tham số.
items.explanationEn: parameter /pəˈræmɪtə(r)/ (noun): a value passed in. "Search parameters" are values that shape the search; "pass a parameter" is a common collocation.

items.question: Trong câu "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", từ "fragment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", what does "fragment" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: fragment /ˈfræɡmənt/ (danh từ): phân đoạn (trong trang). "Fragment" trong URL (#reviews) trỏ tới một vị trí trong trang; nghĩa chung là "mảnh vỡ".
items.explanationEn: fragment /ˈfræɡmənt/ (noun): a part inside a page. A URL "fragment" (#reviews) points to a spot in the page; the general sense is "a broken piece".

items.question: Trong câu "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", từ "position" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", what does "position" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: position /pəˈzɪʃn/ (danh từ): vị trí. "A position within the page" = một vị trí trong trang; "position" còn có nghĩa là chức vụ.
items.explanationEn: position /pəˈzɪʃn/ (noun): a place or location. "A position within the page" is a location in it; "position" can also mean a job.

items.question: Trong câu "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", từ "handle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Fragment: #reviews — a position within the page (handled by the browser).", what does "handle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: handle /ˈhændl/ (động từ): xử lý, đảm nhận. "Handled by the browser" = do trình duyệt xử lý; danh từ "handle" là tay cầm.
items.explanationEn: handle /ˈhændl/ (verb): to deal with. "Handled by the browser" means the browser deals with it; the noun "handle" is a grip.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser resolves DNS: domain → IP", từ "resolve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser resolves DNS: domain → IP", what does "resolve" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to turn a name into an address
items.explanation: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (động từ): phân giải (tên miền). "Resolve DNS" = phân giải tên miền thành địa chỉ IP; "resolve an issue" = giải quyết vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: resolve /rɪˈzɒlv/ (verb): to turn a name into an address. "Resolve DNS" means look up the IP for a name; "resolve an issue" means fix a problem.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser resolves DNS: domain → IP", từ "domain" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser resolves DNS: domain → IP", what does "domain" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (danh từ): tên miền. "Domain → IP" = từ tên miền ra địa chỉ IP; "domain knowledge" = kiến thức nghiệp vụ.
items.explanationEn: domain /dəˈmeɪn/ (noun): a website name. "Domain → IP" maps a site name to an address; "domain knowledge" means business expertise.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", từ "establish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", what does "establish" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (động từ): thiết lập, tạo lập. "Establish a connection" = thiết lập kết nối; cụm rất hay gặp trong tài liệu mạng.
items.explanationEn: establish /ɪˈstæblɪʃ/ (verb): to set up. "Establish a connection" means set one up; a very common collocation in networking docs.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", từ "connection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", what does "connection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: connection /kəˈnekʃn/ (danh từ): kết nối (mạng). "A TCP connection" = một kết nối TCP; "lose connection" = mất kết nối.
items.explanationEn: connection /kəˈnekʃn/ (noun): a network link. "A TCP connection" is a network link between two machines; "lose connection" is common.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", từ "handshake" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser establishes a TCP connection (3-way handshake)", what does "handshake" (noun) mean?
options: bắt tay (trao đổi mở kết nối)
items.explanation: handshake /ˈhændʃeɪk/ (danh từ): bắt tay (trao đổi mở kết nối). "3-way handshake" = bắt tay ba bước để mở kết nối TCP; nghĩa gốc là cái bắt tay.
items.explanationEn: handshake /ˈhændʃeɪk/ (noun): an opening exchange of signals. "3-way handshake" is the three-message exchange that opens a TCP link; literally, shaking hands.

items.question: Trong câu "If HTTPS: add a TLS handshake step (encryption)", từ "encryption" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If HTTPS: add a TLS handshake step (encryption)", what does "encryption" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: encoding data to keep it secret
items.explanation: encryption /ɪnˈkrɪpʃn/ (danh từ): mã hóa. "TLS handshake step (encryption)" = bước bắt tay TLS để mã hóa; trái nghĩa: decryption (giải mã).
items.explanationEn: encryption /ɪnˈkrɪpʃn/ (noun): encoding data to keep it secret. The TLS step sets up encryption so data stays private; the opposite is decryption.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser sends an HTTP GET request to the server", từ "request" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser sends an HTTP GET request to the server", what does "request" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: request /rɪˈkwest/ (danh từ): yêu cầu (gửi tới máy chủ). "Send a request to the server" = gửi yêu cầu tới máy chủ; đi cặp với response (phản hồi).
items.explanationEn: request /rɪˈkwest/ (noun): a message asking a server. "Send a request to the server" pairs with "response"; together they form the HTTP exchange.

items.question: Trong câu "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", từ "receive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", what does "receive" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (động từ): nhận. "The server receives the request" = máy chủ nhận yêu cầu; danh từ: receipt, receiver.
items.explanationEn: receive /rɪˈsiːv/ (verb): to get something sent. "The server receives the request" means it gets it; related nouns: receipt, receiver.

items.question: Trong câu "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", từ "process" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", what does "process" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: process /ˈprəʊses/ (động từ): xử lý. "Processes it" = xử lý yêu cầu; danh từ "process" là quy trình hoặc tiến trình.
items.explanationEn: process /ˈprəʊses/ (verb): to work on data. "Processes it" means works on the request; the noun "process" means a procedure.

items.question: Trong câu "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", từ "response" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The server receives the request, processes it, and returns an HTTP response", what does "response" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (danh từ): phản hồi (từ máy chủ). "Returns an HTTP response" = trả về phản hồi HTTP; "response time" = thời gian phản hồi.
items.explanationEn: response /rɪˈspɒns/ (noun): a reply from a server. "Returns an HTTP response" means sends back a reply; "response time" is a key metric.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser parses the HTML → loads additional CSS, JS, images", từ "parse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser parses the HTML → loads additional CSS, JS, images", what does "parse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: parse /pɑːz/ (động từ): phân tích cú pháp. "Parses the HTML" = phân tích cú pháp HTML để hiểu cấu trúc; "parse JSON" cũng rất phổ biến.
items.explanationEn: parse /pɑːz/ (verb): to analyse structured text. "Parses the HTML" means reads its structure; "parse JSON" is equally common.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser parses the HTML → loads additional CSS, JS, images", từ "additional" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser parses the HTML → loads additional CSS, JS, images", what does "additional" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: additional /əˈdɪʃənl/ (tính từ): bổ sung, thêm. "Loads additional CSS, JS, images" = tải thêm CSS, JS, ảnh; trạng từ: additionally.
items.explanationEn: additional /əˈdɪʃənl/ (adjective): extra, added. "Loads additional CSS, JS, images" means extra files; adverb: additionally.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser renders the page (draws it on the screen)", từ "render" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser renders the page (draws it on the screen)", what does "render" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: render /ˈrendə(r)/ (động từ): kết xuất, vẽ ra. "Renders the page" = kết xuất (vẽ) trang lên màn hình; danh từ: rendering.
items.explanationEn: render /ˈrendə(r)/ (verb): to draw output on screen. "Renders the page" means turns code into what you see; noun: rendering.

items.question: Trong câu "The browser renders the page (draws it on the screen)", từ "draw" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The browser renders the page (draws it on the screen)", what does "draw" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: draw /drɔː/ (động từ): vẽ. "Draws it on the screen" = vẽ nó lên màn hình; "draw" còn nghĩa là kéo hoặc hòa.
items.explanationEn: draw /drɔː/ (verb): to make a picture. "Draws it on the screen" means paints it; "draw" can also mean pull or tie a game.

items.question: Trong câu "Displays the UI, handles user interaction", từ "interaction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Displays the UI, handles user interaction", what does "interaction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: interaction /ˌɪntərˈækʃn/ (danh từ): tương tác. "User interaction" = tương tác của người dùng (bấm, gõ, cuộn); động từ: interact.
items.explanationEn: interaction /ˌɪntərˈækʃn/ (noun): acting with each other. "User interaction" is clicking, typing, scrolling; verb: interact.

items.question: Trong câu "Business logic, database, security", từ "logic" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business logic, database, security", what does "logic" (noun) mean?
options: logic nghiệp vụ, quy tắc xử lý
items.explanation: logic /ˈlɒdʒɪk/ (danh từ): logic nghiệp vụ, quy tắc xử lý. "Business logic" = các quy tắc nghiệp vụ mà backend thực thi; "logical" = hợp lý.
items.explanationEn: logic /ˈlɒdʒɪk/ (noun): the rules a system follows. "Business logic" is the rules the backend enforces; adjective: logical.

items.question: Trong câu "Business logic, database, security", từ "security" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Business logic, database, security", what does "security" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: security /sɪˈkjʊərəti/ (danh từ): bảo mật, an ninh. "Security" ở backend = bảo mật dữ liệu và hệ thống; "securities" số nhiều là chứng khoán.
items.explanationEn: security /sɪˈkjʊərəti/ (noun): protection from threats. Backend "security" means protecting data and systems; plural "securities" are stocks and bonds.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is prebuilt and sent directly to the browser.", từ "prebuilt" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is prebuilt and sent directly to the browser.", what does "prebuilt" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: prebuilt /ˌpriːˈbɪlt/ (tính từ): dựng sẵn từ trước. "The HTML is prebuilt" = HTML được tạo sẵn trước khi có yêu cầu; tiền tố "pre-" = trước.
items.explanationEn: prebuilt /ˌpriːˈbɪlt/ (adjective): made in advance. "The HTML is prebuilt" means made before any request; the prefix "pre-" means before.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is prebuilt and sent directly to the browser.", từ "directly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is prebuilt and sent directly to the browser.", what does "directly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: directly /dəˈrektli/ (trạng từ): trực tiếp. "Sent directly to the browser" = gửi thẳng tới trình duyệt, không qua xử lý; "directly" cũng có nghĩa "thẳng thắn".
items.explanationEn: directly /dəˈrektli/ (adverb): with nothing in between. "Sent directly to the browser" means with no processing step; it can also mean frankly.

items.question: Trong câu "Example: a company introduction page, a simple blog.", từ "introduction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Example: a company introduction page, a simple blog.", what does "introduction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: introduction /ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃn/ (danh từ): giới thiệu. "A company introduction page" = trang giới thiệu công ty; "introduction" cũng nghĩa là sự đưa vào áp dụng.
items.explanationEn: introduction /ˌɪntrəˈdʌkʃn/ (noun): a presentation of something. "A company introduction page" presents the company; it can also mean bringing something new in.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒenəreɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra, sinh ra. "The HTML is generated" = HTML được tạo ra (lúc chạy); "generate a report" = tạo báo cáo.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒenəreɪt/ (verb): to produce. "The HTML is generated" means produced at run time; "generate a report" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", từ "come in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", what does "come in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: come in /kʌm ɪn/ (cụm từ): đến, được gửi tới. "When a request comes in" = khi có yêu cầu gửi đến; "come in!" cũng là "mời vào".
items.explanationEn: come in /kʌm ɪn/ (phrase): to arrive. "When a request comes in" means when one arrives; "Come in!" also invites someone into a room.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", từ "query" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", what does "query" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to ask a database for data
items.explanation: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (động từ): truy vấn (dữ liệu). "Queries the database" = truy vấn cơ sở dữ liệu; "query" cũng nghĩa là nghi vấn điều gì.
items.explanationEn: query /ˈkwɪəri/ (verb): to ask a database for data. "Queries the database" means asks it for data; "to query" can also mean to doubt.

items.question: Trong câu "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", từ "tailored" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The HTML is generated when a request comes in — the server runs code, queries the database, and builds HTML tailored to each user.", what does "tailored" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tailored /ˈteɪləd/ (tính từ): được thiết kế riêng. "Tailored to each user" = được làm riêng cho từng người dùng; gốc từ "tailor" (thợ may).
items.explanationEn: tailored /ˈteɪləd/ (adjective): made to fit a need. "Tailored to each user" means customised for them; from "tailor", a person who makes clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "network" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "network" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: network /ˈnetwɜːk/ (danh từ): mạng lưới (máy chủ). "A network of servers" = mạng lưới máy chủ; động từ "to network" = xây dựng quan hệ.
items.explanationEn: network /ˈnetwɜːk/ (noun): a system of linked computers. "A network of servers" is a linked group of machines; the verb "to network" means make contacts.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "distribute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "distribute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: distribute /dɪˈstrɪbjuːt/ (động từ): phân bố, phân tán. "Distributed around the world" = phân bố khắp thế giới; "distributed system" = hệ thống phân tán.
items.explanationEn: distribute /dɪˈstrɪbjuːt/ (verb): to spread over places. "Distributed around the world" means spread across it; "distributed system" is a key term.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "store" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "store" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: store /stɔː(r)/ (động từ): lưu trữ. "Store copies" = lưu các bản sao; danh từ "store" là cửa hàng, "storage" là bộ nhớ lưu trữ.
items.explanationEn: store /stɔː(r)/ (verb): to keep for later. "Store copies" means keep them; the noun "store" is a shop and "storage" is where data lives.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "copy" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "copy" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: copy /ˈkɒpi/ (danh từ): bản sao. "Store copies of static content" = lưu bản sao nội dung tĩnh; "copy" trong marketing là văn bản quảng cáo.
items.explanationEn: copy /ˈkɒpi/ (noun): a duplicate. "Copies of static content" are duplicates; in marketing, "copy" means advertising text.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "static" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "static" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: static /ˈstætɪk/ (tính từ): tĩnh, không thay đổi. "Static content" = nội dung tĩnh (ảnh, CSS, JS) giống nhau cho mọi người; trái nghĩa: dynamic.
items.explanationEn: static /ˈstætɪk/ (adjective): not changing. "Static content" is the same for everyone; the opposite is dynamic.

items.question: Trong câu "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", từ "content" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A CDN is a network of servers distributed around the world that store copies of static content (images, CSS, JS) on the server closest to the user.", what does "content" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: content /ˈkɒntent/ (danh từ): nội dung. "Static content" = nội dung tĩnh; phát âm /kənˈtent/ (tính từ) nghĩa là hài lòng.
items.explanationEn: content /ˈkɒntent/ (noun): the material shown. "Static content" is material like images; pronounced /kənˈtent/ as an adjective it means satisfied.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", từ "benefit" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", what does "benefit" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: benefit /ˈbenɪfɪt/ (danh từ): lợi ích. "Benefits" = các lợi ích; hay đi cặp "benefits and drawbacks" (ưu và nhược điểm).
items.explanationEn: benefit /ˈbenɪfɪt/ (noun): an advantage. "Benefits" are advantages; often paired as "benefits and drawbacks".

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", từ "reduce" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", what does "reduce" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reduce /rɪˈdjuːs/ (động từ): giảm bớt. "Reduced latency" = độ trễ được giảm; danh từ: reduction.
items.explanationEn: reduce /rɪˈdjuːs/ (verb): to make smaller. "Reduced latency" means lower delay; noun: reduction.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", từ "latency" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", what does "latency" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (danh từ): độ trễ. "Reduced latency" = giảm độ trễ; "low latency" = độ trễ thấp, phản hồi nhanh.
items.explanationEn: latency /ˈleɪtənsi/ (noun): delay in response. "Reduced latency" means less delay; "low latency" means fast responses.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", từ "load" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", what does "load" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the amount of work on a system
items.explanation: load /ləʊd/ (danh từ): tải (khối lượng công việc). "Less load on the origin server" = giảm tải cho máy chủ gốc; "load time" = thời gian tải.
items.explanationEn: load /ləʊd/ (noun): the amount of work on a system. "Less load on the origin server" means less work for it; "load time" is how long a page takes.

items.question: Trong câu "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", từ "origin" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Benefits: reduced latency, faster load times, less load on the origin server.", what does "origin" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: origin /ˈɒrɪdʒɪn/ (danh từ): gốc, nguồn ban đầu. "The origin server" = máy chủ gốc chứa bản chính; "country of origin" = nước xuất xứ.
items.explanationEn: origin /ˈɒrɪdʒɪn/ (noun): the original source. "The origin server" holds the original content; "country of origin" means where a thing comes from.

items.question: Trong câu "In Chrome/Firefox, press F12 to open Dev Tools", từ "press" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In Chrome/Firefox, press F12 to open Dev Tools", what does "press" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: press /pres/ (động từ): nhấn (phím). "Press F12" = nhấn phím F12; danh từ "the press" nghĩa là báo chí.
items.explanationEn: press /pres/ (verb): to push a key. "Press F12" means push that key; the noun "the press" means news media.

items.question: Trong câu "Network tab: view all requests/responses.", từ "view" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Network tab: view all requests/responses.", what does "view" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: view /vjuː/ (động từ): xem. "View all requests" = xem tất cả yêu cầu; "view A as B" = coi A là B.
items.explanationEn: view /vjuː/ (verb): to look at. "View all requests" means look at them; "view A as B" means regard A as B.

items.question: Trong câu "Console: view JavaScript errors.", từ "error" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Console: view JavaScript errors.", what does "error" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: error /ˈerə(r)/ (danh từ): lỗi. "JavaScript errors" = các lỗi JavaScript; "throw an error" = ném ra lỗi.
items.explanationEn: error /ˈerə(r)/ (noun): a mistake or fault. "JavaScript errors" are faults in the code; "throw an error" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Elements: inspect HTML/CSS.", từ "inspect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Elements: inspect HTML/CSS.", what does "inspect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (động từ): kiểm tra, xem xét kỹ. "Inspect HTML/CSS" = xem xét kỹ mã HTML/CSS; tính năng "Inspect element" trong trình duyệt.
items.explanationEn: inspect /ɪnˈspekt/ (verb): to examine closely. "Inspect HTML/CSS" means examine it closely; browsers offer "Inspect element".

items.question: Trong câu "This is the basic tool for understanding what a website is doing.", từ "basic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the basic tool for understanding what a website is doing.", what does "basic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: basic /ˈbeɪsɪk/ (tính từ): cơ bản. "The basic tool" = công cụ cơ bản; "the basics" = những điều cơ bản.
items.explanationEn: basic /ˈbeɪsɪk/ (adjective): fundamental. "The basic tool" is the fundamental one; "the basics" means the fundamentals.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the basic tool for understanding what a website is doing.", từ "tool" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the basic tool for understanding what a website is doing.", what does "tool" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: tool /tuːl/ (danh từ): công cụ. "The basic tool for understanding a website" = công cụ cơ bản để hiểu website; "Dev Tools" = công cụ lập trình viên.
items.explanationEn: tool /tuːl/ (noun): something used for a task. "The basic tool" helps you do a job; "Dev Tools" are developer tools in the browser.

items.question: Trong câu "Status line: the status code.", từ "status" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Status line: the status code.", what does "status" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: status /ˈsteɪtəs/ (danh từ): trạng thái. "The status code" = mã trạng thái (200, 404...); "status" cũng là địa vị xã hội.
items.explanationEn: status /ˈsteɪtəs/ (noun): a current state. "The status code" tells the state of a response; "status" can also mean social rank.

items.question: Trong câu "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", từ "header" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", what does "header" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: extra info sent before the body
items.explanation: header /ˈhedə(r)/ (danh từ): phần đầu (thông tin kèm theo). "Headers" trong HTTP chứa thông tin mô tả phản hồi; trong bóng đá "header" là cú đánh đầu.
items.explanationEn: header /ˈhedə(r)/ (noun): extra info sent before the body. HTTP "headers" carry details about the response; in football a "header" is a shot with the head.

items.question: Trong câu "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", từ "metadata" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", what does "metadata" (noun) mean?
options: siêu dữ liệu (dữ liệu mô tả)
items.explanation: metadata /ˈmetədeɪtə/ (danh từ): siêu dữ liệu (dữ liệu mô tả). "Metadata (content type, size)" = dữ liệu mô tả nội dung; tiền tố "meta-" = về chính nó.
items.explanationEn: metadata /ˈmetədeɪtə/ (noun): data describing other data. "Metadata" describes other data, such as type and size; the prefix "meta-" means "about".

items.question: Trong câu "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", từ "size" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Headers: metadata (content type, size...).", what does "size" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: size /saɪz/ (danh từ): kích thước, dung lượng. "Content type, size" = kiểu nội dung, kích thước; "file size" = dung lượng tệp.
items.explanationEn: size /saɪz/ (noun): how big something is. "Size" here is how many bytes the content has; "file size" is a common phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Body: the actual content (HTML, JSON, images...).", từ "body" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Body: the actual content (HTML, JSON, images...).", what does "body" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the main part of a message
items.explanation: body /ˈbɒdi/ (danh từ): phần thân (nội dung chính). "Body" của phản hồi HTTP là nội dung thực; "a government body" = một cơ quan nhà nước.
items.explanationEn: body /ˈbɒdi/ (noun): the main part of a message. The HTTP "body" is the actual content; "a government body" is an official organisation.

items.question: Trong câu "Body: the actual content (HTML, JSON, images...).", từ "actual" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Body: the actual content (HTML, JSON, images...).", what does "actual" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: actual /ˈæktʃuəl/ (tính từ): thực sự, thật. "The actual content" = nội dung thực sự; lưu ý "actual" không có nghĩa là "hiện tại".
items.explanationEn: actual /ˈæktʃuəl/ (adjective): real, not imagined. "The actual content" is the real content; note that "actual" does not mean "current".

items.question: Trong câu "URL = the full address including scheme, host, path, query.", từ "including" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "URL = the full address including scheme, host, path, query.", what does "including" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: including /ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ/ (giới từ): bao gồm. "Including scheme, host, path, query" = bao gồm các phần đó; trái nghĩa: excluding.
items.explanationEn: including /ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ/ (preposition): containing as part. "Including scheme, host, path, query" lists the parts; the opposite is "excluding".

items.question: Trong câu "CDN: a distributed network of servers to increase speed.", từ "increase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CDN: a distributed network of servers to increase speed.", what does "increase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: increase /ɪnˈkriːs/ (động từ): tăng. "Increase speed" = tăng tốc độ; trái nghĩa: decrease, reduce.
items.explanationEn: increase /ɪnˈkriːs/ (verb): to make greater. "Increase speed" means make it faster; opposites: decrease, reduce.

items.question: Trong câu "CDN: a distributed network of servers to increase speed.", từ "distributed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CDN: a distributed network of servers to increase speed.", what does "distributed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (tính từ): phân tán. "A distributed network" = mạng phân tán ở nhiều nơi; trái nghĩa: centralised.
items.explanationEn: distributed /dɪˈstrɪbjuːtɪd/ (adjective): spread across many places. "A distributed network" is spread across many places; the opposite is centralised.

items.question: Trong câu "Dev Tools (F12): tools for debugging and exploring a website.", từ "debug" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dev Tools (F12): tools for debugging and exploring a website.", what does "debug" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: debug /ˌdiːˈbʌɡ/ (động từ): gỡ lỗi. "Tools for debugging" = công cụ gỡ lỗi; "bug" = lỗi phần mềm.
items.explanationEn: debug /ˌdiːˈbʌɡ/ (verb): to find and fix bugs. "Tools for debugging" help find and fix faults; a "bug" is a software fault.

items.question: Trong câu "Dev Tools (F12): tools for debugging and exploring a website.", từ "explore" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Dev Tools (F12): tools for debugging and exploring a website.", what does "explore" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː(r)/ (động từ): khám phá, tìm hiểu. "Exploring a website" = tìm hiểu một website; danh từ: exploration.
items.explanationEn: explore /ɪkˈsplɔː(r)/ (verb): to look around to learn. "Exploring a website" means looking around to learn how it works; noun: exploration.
